subject: Nominee credit allocation for Founders Summit program — verification needed
messages:
From: Elena Garcia <elena@founders-summit.org>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
Cc: program@founders-summit.org
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: nominee credits for Founders Summit cohort (CSV + MOU attached)

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for being open to sponsoring a block of credits for a handful of our cohort nominees. Attached is the nominee list (CSV) and our standard MOU. Can you confirm eligibility for these early-stage founders and whether Redwood can issue self-serve credits directly to each company?

Quick context: this is the Founders Summit (late July demo day). We typically nominate 8-10 companies that are pre-seed / seed, 0-12 employees, and typically backed by micro-VCs or angels. We're asking for up to $25k credits per company with a 6-month expiry window.

Attachments: [Attachment: founders_nominees.csv (csv, 14KB)], [Attachment: MOU_FoundersSummit.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if you prefer.

Thanks,
Elena Garcia
Program Director — Founders Summit
Elena@founders-summit.org

--
On Fri, Jun 26, 2026 at 09:20 Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference> wrote:
> (internal note: leaving here for audit trail)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Garcia <elena@founders-summit.org>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, program@founders-summit.org
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: nominee credits for Founders Summit cohort (CSV + MOU attached)

Elena — thanks for the packet and the clear ask. I looped in Laura (program credits ops) and Ben (billing) to validate eligibility and issuance flow.

A couple quick items from our side so we can move fast:
- Can you confirm investor status (YC / micro-VC / angel) and that no company has raised > $5M (pre-seed / seed only)?
- Do you need an individual credit grant per company (direct email to founders) or will the program distribute a single pool to the cohort?
- Are there any additional compliance / data residency constraints (some international nominees are from EU).

If all looks good we can do self-serve grant links with 6-month expiry. I also attached a one-line MOU redline suggestion (we prefer a short credit grant addendum).

If convenient, Laura, can you run quick checks on the CSV and flag any obviously ineligible entries? Ben — once Laura confirms, what's the quickest way to kick issuance from finance?

Thanks — Vivek
VP, Partnerships & Programs
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_MOU_Addendum.docx (docx, 6KB)]
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Cc: Elena Garcia <elena@founders-summit.org>, program@founders-summit.org
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 10:28:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: nominee credits for Founders Summit cohort (CSV + MOU attached)

Hi all,

I reviewed the CSV you sent, Elena. Quick findings:
- Total nominees: 9 rows.
- 7 clearly meet our PLG-program criteria (pre-seed / seed, < $5M raised, < 20 employees).
- 2 entries show Series A filings in public records (recommend we mark those ineligible).

Recommended approach:
1) Approve 7 companies for direct, per-company self-serve credits at $20k each with 6-month expiry.
2) For the 2 Series A companies, offer a 30-day trial extension instead (to keep them engaged).

Ben, for issuance I recommend using the console bulk grant flow (creates unique grant links per recipient). That generates a CSV with grant codes we can hand back to Elena. HubSpot integration: I can add a grant URL to each contact record so Elena can track redemption.

Link to suggested console flow: https://app.redwood.inference/console/grants/bulk
HubSpot ticket (created): https://crm.hubspot.com/contacts/FS-2026-019

Laura Bennett
Programs Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Garcia <elena@founders-summit.org>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, program@founders-summit.org
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval: Founders Summit nominee grants — next steps & delivery

Elena — good news: we've approved 7 nominee grants at $20k each (6-month expiry). Two Series A companies are set for a 30-day trial extension.

What to expect next (timeline):
- Today: Ben will run the bulk grant flow and generate unique grant links + redemption codes.
- Within 2 hours: encrypted ZIP (CSV with codes) will be shared with you and the signed MOU addendum attached.
- You can distribute grant links directly to founders or forward the CSV — whichever you prefer.

Ben — please confirm you pushed the grants and paste the secure download link here. Laura — please attach the signed MOU addendum to the delivery.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. We appreciate Founders Summit partnering with Redwood — happy to support the cohort.

— Vivek
VP, Partnerships & Programs
Redwood Inference
